comparison_integrity.correction_rule: Rebuild affected text subsets, contrasts, means, intervals and outcomes on pinned inputs. Reuse indices only for identical block identities; preserve old reports.

deferred.prerequisites: Compatible independently declared intervention records, distinct from full expressible support.
Deferred Layer B contract, not an additional Phase 1 diversity score.
Admissible interventions, compatible probability thresholds and repeated fixed-model evidence.
Validated diagnostics that do not inject the missing solution; UD-007 is deferred.
Validated resolutions, concentration and stability thresholds, repeated evidence.
SI categorical closed-resampling assumptions and n > 1; corpus token count is not n.
Compatible recursive training transitions and an appropriate decay regime; calls are not rounds.
Validated pre/post expressibility, a missing reference set and independently grounded intervention; empty denominator is undefined, never zero or one.
Approved soft-membership estimator with classification uncertainty kept separate.
A justified realization-space estimator; lexical variation is not exact entropy.
Declared matched counterfactuals, consequence criteria and a distance estimator.
Matched constraint interventions; concentration alone cannot identify its cause.
Linked upstream specifications and output classes under a validated transmission design.
